subject: Re: May 30 service interruption — compensation request
messages:
From: Evan Price <evan.price@bluehaven.com>
To: david.kim@redwood.ai
Cc: Priya Sethi <priya.sethi@bluehaven.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: May 30 incident — impact and request for remediation credits

Hi David,

We saw a significant service disruption on May 30 between ~02:45 and 04:30 UTC that affected checkout inference calls for our US region. During that window our storefront saw ~18% checkout failures (retries masked some impact but conversion dropped noticeably). Engineering attached a short log and a summary sheet with token counts and error rates.

We rely on Redwood for low-latency recommendation scoring in the critical checkout path; this disruption directly impacted revenue. Given the customer-visible impact we would like to discuss a remediation package — specifically a token credit to cover the failed requests and a short trial extension to offset lost evaluation time while we validate stability.

Requested:
- Token credit estimate: covers 200k tokens consumed during retries/failed responses (we've attached a usage CSV and summary).
- Trial extension: +30 days for our trial promotional bundle so we can complete the regression test window.

Appreciate a prompt reply — we have an upcoming board demo next week and need to confirm resiliency commitments.

Thanks,
Evan Price
Head of Platform, BlueHaven Retail

From: david.kim@redwood.ai
To: Evan Price <evan.price@bluehaven.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: May 30 incident — impact and request for remediation credits

Evan — thanks for the quick note and the attachments. I'm really sorry BlueHaven saw that impact.

Quick update while we investigate: our infra team ran a post-mortem and identified an autoscaling regression in the US-west routing layer that caused request queuing during a brief backing-off event. Engineering has a mitigation patch that rolled out at 05:10 UTC and we've confirmed topology is stable.

Action items from our side:
- Marissa (cc) will compile an itemized token estimate and propose a credits package.
- I'll loop in our finance/ops for approval and share the proposed package and timeline today.
- We can extend the trial window while you validate the fix — tell us the exact start date you want that to cover.

Again — really sorry for the disruption. We'll prioritize this and get you a clear remediation offer within 24 hours.

Best,
David Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

Hi Evan — I pulled the usage window and validated the numbers. Summary below (we kept it conservative):

Observed impact (05/30 02:40–04:35 UTC):
- Failed/partial responses: ~180k tokens (customer-side retries accounted for ~20k additional token attempts)
- Effective lost tokens: ~200k tokens (rounded)

Marissa's proposed remediation (pending approvals):
- Goodwill token credit: 50,000 tokens (applied to your account as a first-tier remediation)
- Trial extension: 14 days added to existing promotional window (to allow your engineering team a short revalidation)
- Additional discretionary credit: up to 150,000 tokens contingent on leadership approval and sign-off of a short mutual action plan (MAP) that commits to an incident validation test.

Rationale: we want to provide immediate relief (fast token grant) while reviewing the fuller impact for a larger top-up. If you want the larger package we'll need a quick confirmation of the MAP and an internal approval (finance + sales leadership).

Next steps:
1) Evan — confirm you want the 14-day extension start date (we can start it on 2027-05-31).
2) David/Jonas — can we get leadership approval for the discretionary top-up if BlueHaven signs the MAP?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
